title.zh: 膜运输 · 扩散、渗透与泵
title.en: Membrane transport · diffusion, osmosis and pumps

description.zh: 分子在膜两侧随机来回穿越，浓度高的一侧穿过来的更多，于是出现顺着浓度差的净流动（扩散）；水跟着溶质浓度走（渗透），细胞随之胀大或皱缩；想逆着浓度差搬运，就要消耗 ATP 让泵来做。
description.en: Molecules cross a membrane at random in both directions, but more come from the crowded side, giving a net flow down the concentration difference (diffusion); water follows the solute concentration (osmosis), swelling or shrinking the cell; moving things against the difference takes ATP-powered pumps.

zh: 高渗 低渗 等渗
红细胞放进清水会怎样
en: what happens to a red blood cell in pure water

label.en: The cell membrane is the gate

reason.zh: 细胞靠一层膜把内外分开；膜对不同物质的通透性不同，内外浓度才能维持差异，也才谈得上谁进谁出。
reason.en: A cell keeps inside and outside apart with a membrane; because the membrane lets different substances through to different degrees, inside and outside can hold different concentrations, and it makes sense to ask what goes in and what comes out.

label.zh: 扩散来自分子的随机运动
label.en: Diffusion comes from random molecular motion

reason.zh: 分子一直在乱动，单个分子往哪边跑都可能；只是浓度高的一侧分子更多，统计上穿过去的更多，净通量才顺着浓度差。
reason.en: Molecules are always jostling, and any single one may go either way; there are simply more on the crowded side, so statistically more cross from there, and the net flux runs down the gradient.

label.zh: 离子梯度是静息电位的本钱
label.en: Ion gradients are what the resting potential spends

reason.zh: 钠钾泵耗能把 K⁺ 泵进、Na⁺ 泵出，建立膜内外的离子浓度差；K⁺ 顺着浓度差从漏通道漏出，膜内就变负，这就是静息电位。
reason.en: The sodium–potassium pump spends energy moving K⁺ in and Na⁺ out, building concentration differences across the membrane; K⁺ leaking back out through its channels leaves the inside negative — the resting potential.
